2609.33774.title: Tokens Change, Structure Endures: Spectral Watermarking for Generated Speech
2609.33774.paper_summary: Watermarking is a promising tool for establishing the provenance of AI-generated speech. While many neural audio watermarking methods rely on a separately trained watermark generator, token-level watermarking is a training-free alternative that operates directly during generation. Its main weakness is retokenization: decoding generated speech to a waveform and encoding it again can change token identities and erode the watermark. To make the watermark robust to these changes, we propose Redwing, REtokenization-Durable Watermarking IN Generation. It builds a graph from the token substitutions observed under retokenization, whose Laplacian yields a basis that assigns similar values to tokens likely to substitute for one another. Over this basis, embedding and detection functions are jointly optimized to preserve watermark signal through retokenization while limiting embedding distortion and detector variability on unwatermarked speech. On the Moshi full-duplex system, after eight consecutive passes of Mimi resynthesis, Redwing achieves 80.7% TPR at a calibrated 1% FPR, compared with 8.3% for KGW and at most 7.3% for WMAR. It also has the highest TPR after eight passes through three other neural codecs (77.5-93.0%), and the gains generalize to TTS models at a speech-quality cost close to that of KGW. These results show that retokenization is not merely a source of noise: its transition structure can be exploited as a design principle for robust token-level watermarking.
2609.33774.paper_summary_zh: 水印技術是一種有前途的工具，用於確立AI生成語音的來源。雖然許多神經音頻水印方法依賴於單獨訓練的水印生成器，但基於標記的水印是一種無需訓練的替代方案，直接在生成過程中運作。它的主要弱點是重新標記：將生成的語音解碼為波形並再次編碼可能會改變標記身份並侵蝕水印。為了使水印對這些變化具有魯棒性，我們提出了Redwing，即生成中的REtokenization-Durable Watermarking。它從在重新標記下觀察到的標記替換中構建圖形，其拉普拉斯算子產生一個基底，為可能相互替換的標記分配相似的值。在這個基底上，嵌入和檢測函數被聯合優化，以在重新標記過程中保護水印信號，同時限制嵌入失真和未水印語音的檢測器變異性。在Moshi全雙工系統上，經過八次連續的Mimi重合成，Redwing在經過校準的1%假陽性率下達到80.7%的真陽性率，而KGW為8.3%，WMAR最多為7.3%。在經過三個其他神經編解碼器的八次通過後，它也達到了最高的真陽性率（77.5-93.0%），而這些增益在語音質量成本接近KGW的情況下對TTS模型也具有普遍性。這些結果表明，重新標記不僅僅是噪音的來源：它的轉換結構可以被利用作為設計魯棒的標記級水印的原則。
